claims.evidence: Camera body model number is not legible in any photo; only the Nikon logo is visible, so the exact body (D3400 vs another model) cannot be confirmed.
Photo 1 shows the lens barrel text 'Nikon AF-P DX Nikkor 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED'.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the camera powered on, shutter firing, autofocus working, or LCD displaying; functionality cannot be assessed from static photos.

risks.risk: Camera body may not actually be a D3400, or could be a lower/older model misrepresented by the seller.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model name/badge on the body (front near lens mount or top plate) or the serial/model sticker on the base.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unspecified/entry-level Nikon DSLR body, not confirmed as D3400.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have shutter, autofocus, button, or LCD faults despite seller's claim.
risks.proof: Short video clip showing power-on, menu navigation, shutter firing, and autofocus lens movement.

risks.risk: Lens glass could have scratches, haze, or fungus not visible in the given shots.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements against a light source, and through the aperture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having significant optical defects.

risks.risk: High shutter actuation count or sensor dust/damage could reduce value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count (via EXIF tool) or a sensor photo at small aperture.

risks.risk: Visible grip wear and paint loss suggest heavy handling, possibly hiding internal wear.
risks.proof: Additional close-up photos of all sides, especially underside and battery compartment, showing wear extent.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case cosmetic grade (heavily used).

risks.risk: Unclear if battery, charger, memory card, lens cap, or strap are included.
risks.proof: Photo of all accessories laid out together with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body and lens only, no accessories.

proof_requests: Photo of the body's model name/serial sticker (top plate or base) to confirm it is a D3400.
Video showing camera powering on, shutter firing, autofocus engaging, and LCD screen working.
Close-up photos of front and rear lens elements for scratches/haze/fungus.
Shutter count screenshot or sensor condition photo.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, card, strap, cap).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR with the stated 70-300mm lens, so it can be priced at worst case for an unconfirmed body model with unverified function and condition, pending the listed proofs.
